title: Martial Arts Combat Combo Motion Sheet
summary: Motion-sheet prompt for a martial arts combat module, documenting combo poses, arrows, timing windows, hit beats, and animator-friendly panel notes.
prompt:
Create a 4x4 combat animation motion sheet for a martial arts game character. The output should look like an animator and combat designer reference for a playable combo chain, not a generic pose diagram.

Style: monochrome grayscale 3D-rendered character, clean instructional panel grid, thin borders, numbered cells 1-16, directional arrows, timing labels, hit-beat markers, and readable full-body silhouettes.

Panel structure: each cell includes pose title, frame range, input notation, movement arrows, hitbox intent, recovery notes, and whether the beat is anticipation, active strike, cancel window, or recovery.

Combo content: opening guard, forward step, palm feint, elbow strike, low sweep, launcher, aerial turn, downward kick, ground follow-up, parry reset, stamina recovery pose, and finisher stance.

Production constraints: consistent character scale, no camera drift, no unclear limb overlaps, game-feel annotations for hitstop and cancel timing, and enough clean margin for engine or animation-state-machine notes.
